Trade > Bridge - with info > Start bridge > Post wallet interaction 1440, read live 2026-09-14 (get_design_context) and diffed against its parent 13006-248937 with node ids and asset urls normalised away. THE TWO BOARDS ARE IDENTICAL, byte for byte, apart from the frame's own name — every class, every padding, every string, the same 1.2 amount, the same $21.78, the same green ring on the send leg, the same 'Bridge in progress...' CTA. So the board that is supposed to specify the ticket AFTER the wallet has been through specifies nothing its parent did not: no pending, no success, no failure, no explorer link. The live surface has all four and they were kept rather than deleted to match a board that draws none. NOT a match line and NOT a code defect: the screen the catalog asks for does not exist in the file, and the decision is a design one. Same finding carried to 13006-257631 and 13006-254715, neither re-read.

MEASURED, DELIBERATELY NOT BUILT: the rail is EVM-only and an external wallet here is an auth method for the embedded wallet, not a second custody surface to connect and save. The 24px gear the frame parks in the tab header to open it is kept at its measured size and carries the ticket's own flow controls instead. bridgeTicket.figma.test.ts greps the comment-stripped source for a Solana leg so a later parity pass fails rather than adding one.
